description: Create a new agent endpoint after you have obtained a valid X-Payment payload for the creation challenge. Requires a dashboard PAT with mcp:endpoints:write or mcp:*.

accessToken.description: Your dashboard MCP personal access token (sgl_pat_*). Can be omitted when the connection sends Authorization: Bearer sgl_pat_*

chain.description: Primary payout network, usually base, solana, or both

listOnMarketplace.description: Whether to list the endpoint publicly

originUrl.description: Origin URL of the endpoint backend

paymentPayload.description: Raw X-Payment payload returned by the paying client, as JSON or base64 string

price.description: Price per request or base package price

purchaseAmount.description: USDC amount to pay on creation, minimum 5

slug.description: Unique slug for the new endpoint

walletAddressSecondary.description: Secondary wallet when chain is both

name: create_endpoint_with_payment
